source_review.method: Primary company report read through web and normal configured page-reader extraction; no article body retained.
source_review.finding: Topical PP405 for androgenetic alopecia. The report describes 78 participants, four weeks of dosing, safety/pharmacokinetic objectives and an exploratory week-eight density response in a subgroup of men with more extensive hair loss. It does not establish benefit across the whole population, comparative superiority, sustained benefit or approval.

source_review.method: Current public caption read in the browser on 2026-11-16. Caption-only source review, not a fresh app lookup or image inspection.

trial_review.source: Fresh ClinicalTrials.gov structured records with payloads/timestamps retained privately in pp405-primary-records.json and the normal evidence database.

records.scope: PP405 0.05% topical gel, adults aged 18–55 of both sexes with androgenetic alopecia; 78 actual participants; completed phase 2 with posted results.
records.details: The registry healthy-volunteers flag is true, but inclusion explicitly requires androgenetic alopecia; it is not a wrong-indication healthy-only study. Twenty primary safety/tolerability outcomes are retained as the total; the standard public selection shows three, with their original randomized/extension timing. Hair-density subgroup claims remain source-reported statements, not primary registry results.

records.scope: AWAKEN: same topical product in men aged 18–55 with androgenetic alopecia; 600 planned; actual start 2026-09-21; phase 2/3, under way.
records.details: Week-24 hair-count primary outcome; extended treatment through week 52. Existing status rules intentionally count a combined phase trial at its lower phase; keep derived Phase 2.

records.scope: Same topical product in women aged 18–65 with androgenetic alopecia; 200 planned; phase 2, not yet recruiting; estimated November start only.
records.details: Verified intervention/indication and approved as assistant, preserving the score. Fetch adds only its October 30 registration event, not an invented start. Week-24 hair-count outcome.

trial_review.events: Seven approved registry events; six approved by rule before the manual match review, then one registration event fetched normally. No fabricated efficacy or approval event.
trial_review.papers: One low-scored ex-vivo conference abstract remains pending; other unrelated papers remain rejected. No origin paper invented.

publication_review.workflow: No private duplicate found. Normal extraction creates claim 576 with rule approval and early-human stage. Prepare completes in 22 seconds, including 14-second resolve, one-second fetch and six-second readings. After approving the additional match, targeted fetch/readings process only that record; two unchanged records are reused.
publication_review.decisions: Assistant approves match 18002 and subgroup statement 2915 only, retaining scores. Three other low-confidence statements remain pending; one copied statement was refused by extraction. Claim stays approved by rule and checked_by_person false.
publication_review.summary: Corrected headline/summary explicitly attribute the early findings and exploratory subgroup, distinguish the later trials, and avoid an approval or established long-term efficacy claim. Approach set to drug. First-report date is the earliest attached report, 2025-06-17.
publication_review.normal_export: 176 cards: one addition, 170 prior cards identical, five prior cards change only the read_at of shared ROR records. No topic, clinical, trial, status or article change on those existing cards. No snapshot splicing.
